name: LaunchJury
oneLiner: Generates and scores launch assets for indie developers releasing a side project.
whatItDoes: LaunchJury takes a repo (local path or GitHub URL), reads its README/manifests/source, researches how comparable products landed on Hacker News, Reddit, Product Hunt and Indie Hackers, validates the positioning against eight launch principles, and drafts a full set of launch assets: a Show HN title/post/first comment, a Product Hunt tagline/description/maker comment, an X thread, a LinkedIn post, per-subreddit Reddit posts, and demo/launch video scripts. Seven weighted AI juror personas (HN veteran, PH coach, Reddit mod, X growth marketer, dev-tools copywriter, demo director, skeptical target user) score every asset, predict the top comment it would get, and list must-fix edits; a deterministic foreman aggregates scores and a reviser rewrites drafts until they pass (weighted average ≥7.5, no asset below 6) or the round limit (default 2) is hit. Output is a single self-contained report.html plus markdown assets and JSON artifacts per stage in out/<project>/.
howItWorks: A CLI (npx tsx src/cli.ts <repo>) runs an 8-stage pipeline built on the Claude Agent SDK: resolve → ingest (reads code, asks audience/goal/tone) → research (deterministic HN Algolia + Reddit prefetch, then a Sonnet agent with web-search/MCP tools extracts quotes/objections/competitors) → validate (Opus scores 8 weighted positioning principles) → distribute (Sonnet ranks channels/timing/sequence) → draft (Opus writes all assets in parallel) → jury (7 parallel Sonnet/Opus personas score + a pure-TypeScript foreman aggregates + reviser loop, up to N rounds) → report (renders static HTML/markdown, no external requests). Each LLM stage is a single query() call with a zod-validated JSON-schema output, and every stage's artifact is written to disk so runs can be resumed with --from <stage>. Supports --mock/--mock-research for offline demo, --budget to cap spend (real runs cost ~$2-4).
keyFeatures: Reads a repo's code/README to understand the actual product before drafting anything
Deterministic prefetch of real Hacker News and Reddit data plus an AI research analyst that cites quotes and URLs
Eight-principle validation scorecard (clarity, audience, differentiation, why-now, proof, objections, credibility, ask/friction)
Seven weighted AI juror personas that score drafts, predict the audience's top comment, and demand must-fix edits
Deterministic, unit-tested foreman that aggregates jury scores and gates pass/fail reproducibly
Automatic revision loop (reviser + re-jury) until assets pass or rounds run out
Full asset set: Show HN, Product Hunt, X thread, LinkedIn, per-subreddit Reddit posts, demo video script, launch video script
Ranked distribution plan with best channels, timing, tags, and a day-by-day launch sequence
Single self-contained report.html with copy buttons, plus per-stage JSON artifacts for resumable runs
Mock/offline replay mode and a configurable spend budget
differentiatorsClaimed: Grounds every draft and score in real research (actual HN/Reddit quotes with URLs) rather than generic marketing advice
Scores drafts against a reproducible, weighted, multi-persona jury instead of a single generic AI review
Deterministic foreman with unit tests makes pass/fail scoring reproducible, not just an LLM vibe check
Produces the full launch kit (posts + video scripts + distribution plan) in one run rather than just a tagline generator
Read-only, sandboxed agents that never see the user's CLAUDE.md; single self-contained HTML report with no external requests
targetAudience: A solo indie hacker or side-project developer who just finished building something and has never written a Show HN post or Product Hunt launch
